prepare: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg lsb-release

sudo sh -c 'set -eu
umask 077
stage=$(mktemp -d /tmp/karakoram-artifact.XXXXXXXXXX)
trap '"'"'rm -rf -- "$stage"'"'"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cd "$stage"
set -C
file='"'"'percona-release.deb'"'"'
test ! -e "$file" && test ! -L "$file"
curl -fsSL '"'"'https://repo.percona.com/apt/percona-release_latest.noble_all.deb'"'"' > "$file"
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'10a419065480e4cd4ad6d1036e742832203e79ff537461115361ec2f7ff62e36  percona-release.deb'"'"' | sha256sum -c -
if DPKG_DEB_THREADS_MAX=1 apt-get install -y "$stage/$file"; then
:
else
status=$?
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "native artifact $file: package installation failed (exit $status; serial decompression enabled); inspect apt/dpkg diagnostics and allocation memory limits" >&2
exit "$status"
fi
'

printf '#!/bin/sh
exit 101
' | sudo tee /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d >/dev/null && sudo chmod 0755 /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d && sudo apt-get install -y postgresql-common && printf 'create_main_cluster = false
' | sudo tee /etc/postgresql-common/createcluster.conf >/dev/null

sudo env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y percona-postgresql-17='2:17.11-1.noble' percona-postgresql-contrib='1:293-1.noble' percona-patroni='1:4.1.5-1.noble' percona-pgbackrest='1:2.59.1-1.noble' etcd-server='1:3.5.33-1.noble' etcd-client='1:3.5.33-1.noble' python3-etcd3gw python3-psycopg2
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl

sudo sh -c 'set -eu
umask 077
stage=$(mktemp -d /tmp/karakoram-artifact.XXXXXXXXXX)
trap '"'"'rm -rf -- "$stage"'"'"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cd "$stage"
set -C
file='"'"'proxysql_3.0.11-ubuntu24_amd64.deb'"'"'
test ! -e "$file" && test ! -L "$file"
curl -fsSL '"'"'https://github.com/sysown/proxysql/releases/download/v3.0.11/proxysql_3.0.11-ubuntu24_amd64.deb'"'"' > "$file"
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'cda9e28707c944ef673dac2a37b7d0c96b5d11c8df49daccaf377495c8ea69ff  proxysql_3.0.11-ubuntu24_amd64.deb'"'"' | sha256sum -c -
if DPKG_DEB_THREADS_MAX=1 apt-get install -y "$stage/$file"; then
:
else
status=$?
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "native artifact $file: package installation failed (exit $status; serial decompression enabled); inspect apt/dpkg diagnostics and allocation memory limits" >&2
exit "$status"
fi
'
if [ -d /run/systemd/system ]; then sudo systemctl disable --now proxysql.service && sudo systemctl mask proxysql.service; fi
